one_liner: Generative AI platform/CLI for creating images and videos (motion transfer, image/video generation models) via API.

auth.notes: Custom API key scheme using a key ID + secret pair, called an 'API key' by the vendor, sent via a custom 'Key' auth scheme rather than Bearer.

access.notes: console.higgsfield.ai/cloud.higgsfield.ai appears to allow self-serve account creation and key generation; free-tier/credit details not directly confirmed via fetched page.

api.notes: Async request/poll/webhook pattern for generative media models; separate npm CLI (@higgsfield/cli) that authenticates via browser login. Docs mention Skills/MCP compatibility for coding agents but no confirmed dedicated official MCP server URL.

verdict.rationale: Documented REST API with key-based auth and a CLI/SDKs available, appears self-serve though free-tier details are unconfirmed.
